title: Family Unity
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 5 Christian Religious Education; not yet checked by a CRE teacher; not loaded by the live tutor

skills.key_step: The child describes why family unity matters, names challenges families face (quarrels, money worries, distance, alcohol), and outlines what a child can do (obey, help with chores, forgive, pray) as Colossians 3:13-14 teaches.

floor.question: What does Matthew 5:39 teach about revenge?
floor.answer: Do not pay back evil with evil

representations: a family hand: each finger a member, the palm love
steps: Say what unity is: living in love, helping and forgiving.
Name what a child can do about it.

board.do: Draw a hand and write "love" on the palm.

board.say: What can a child do to help the family stay united?

board.do: Wait for the child to name a way.
Write a way on each finger.

misconceptions.repair: Read Colossians 3:13-14: bear with each other and forgive. That assumes there are things to forgive.

misconceptions.ask: Who can help to make a family happy?
misconceptions.repair: List three things a child can do: chores, kind words, obedience.

listen_for: To pretend nothing wrong was done
misconceptions.ask: What does it mean to forgive a family member?
misconceptions.repair: Say what Colossians 3:13 asks: forgive as the Lord forgave you.
Read Colossians 3:13-14: what binds a family is love. List things that cost nothing and build unity.

checks.question: Does a united family never disagree?
checks.answer: No: it forgives and works it out

checks.question: Who can help make a family happy?
